_about: Trigger-rate eval set per https://agentskills.io/skill-creation/optimizing-descriptions. 10 should-trigger + 10 should-not-trigger queries spanning the five activation contexts (designing, ADR-writing, reviewing, rule-explaining, tagging) and near-miss negatives (coding/CI/DB-ops with shared keywords). Run via skill-creator or a custom harness; suggested 3 runs per query, threshold 0.5.

evals.query: Help me sketch a C4 container diagram for an e-commerce checkout — orders, payments, notifications, an external Stripe integration, and a Postgres for orders. PlantUML if possible.
I want to map out a small order-pipeline: an HTTP-facing service, a queue worker, a write-only DB. What does that look like?
Write me an ADR for the decision to put an Anti-corruption Layer in front of our legacy CRM instead of letting services call it directly.
We've decided to switch from direct DB access to a repo-per-service pattern. Need to document this somewhere — the team wants a one-pager that captures the trade-off.
I have an architecture.puml in this folder. Can you check it's reasonable and suggest fixes?
aact check is failing with 'orders directly accesses database orders_db — add a repo or relay'. Why and how do I fix it?
what does the crud rule actually mean? why does aact want a separate repo service?
explain cohesion vs coupling in the context of microservice boundaries — i need to understand whether our checkout boundary is too leaky
I'm adding a service that wraps SendGrid for transactional email. What tag should it have so the rules don't complain?

i'm doing the architecture review for q2 — got 5 microservices already in workspace.dsl, need to (1) walk through which patterns each follows, (2) write 2 ADRs for the decisions we made last quarter, (3) verify the whole thing is clean
Generate a Dockerfile for my Node.js microservice with a multi-stage build.
what's the best way to roll out a microservice update to my Kubernetes cluster with zero downtime?
Refactor this OrderProcessor class to use the Strategy pattern — too many if-else branches.
Write unit tests for my CRUD endpoints — I have GET/POST/PUT/DELETE for /users and want jest tests covering happy path and 404s.
How do I add a composite index on (user_id, created_at) to my Postgres orders table without locking it?
code review for this React component — i think there's a useEffect dependency bug
Set up a GitHub Actions workflow to run tests + lint on PRs for my microservices monorepo.
Draw an ER diagram in Mermaid for our orders / customers / line_items tables.
Write a README section explaining the high-level architecture of my Express + React + Postgres app for new contributors.
